'''Maill''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Maill system/Legends|Maill system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was well-known for having produced one of the rarest coins in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; the world's [[King/Legends|King]] had commissioned the coin in honor of his wife. The coin was minted from a special alloy to have the color of a flaming sunset&mdash;to match the color of the lady's hair. The alloy ended up destroying the minting machines and only a few hundred coins were produced.
